name: team-project
description: Team Project: shared project memory and threads for a team, from a Team Project server.

apiBaseUrl.title: API base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Team Project server. The team server is http://10.20.6.4:5080 (needs the company VPN).

token.title: API token
token.description: Your personal Team Project API token.

uploadTranscript.title: Upload thread transcripts
uploadTranscript.description: Upload each turn of a picked thread, filtered for secrets and personal data by gitleaks and the plugin's own rules, so the team can search it. Needs gitleaks installed.
